lines.say: acts on the ghrelin receptor to prompt growth hormone release
growth hormone rose in 48 healthy men, falling back to very low within 6 hours
stomach and gut movement is stimulated
no human data for injection under the skin, the way it is used today
its main goal in a 117-patient surgery trial, time to first tolerated meal, wasn't met
high blood sugar at discharge was more common than with placebo in the trial
low potassium was more common than with placebo in the surgery trial
IGF-1 checked, as with other drugs that raise growth hormone
FDA flags possible immune reactions from aggregation and impurities
two deaths and serious complications in the surgery trial; causality not reported

ask: Since the only treatment trial failed and there are no human data for injection under the skin, what would make this worth the risk for me?
